basic_details.job_title: Shri Tulsidas Udayraj Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Teacher, Assistant Professor Posts
basic_details.short_information: Shri Tulsidas Udayraj Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya (श्री तुलसीदास उदयराज संस्कृत महाविद्यालय), Chitrakhor-Barahuan (Bankati), Basti, has invited applications for 3 full-time aided teaching posts: Teacher Navya Vyakaran, Assistant Teacher Sahitya and Teacher Modern Subject (Hindi). Each post has 1 unreserved vacancy. Applications go by registered post to the Manager of the college and must reach the college within 21 days of the date the advertisement was issued. The advertisement appeared in the newspapers Dainik Aaj and Amar Ujala from 28 October 2026 to 30 October 2026.

qualification.details: All 3 posts are full-time and aided. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application by registered post (पंजीकृत पत्र) to this address: Manager, Shri Tulsi Das Uday Raj Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya, Chitrakhor, Bankati Basti, PIN Code- 272123.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All 3 posts are full-time and aided. They will be filled under the reservation rules in force from the Uttar Pradesh Government (उ०प्र० शासन), in the admissible pay scale (अनुमन्य वेतनमान). The notice does not give the amount of the pay scale. The notice gives one qualification for all three posts: Essential: Postgraduate (स्नातकोत्तर) in the concerned subject, passed in at least second division. Preference: Candidates with a traditional degree (परम्परागत उपाधि) get preference. Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Each application must include: A bank draft of Rs. 1000 (rupees one thousand) from any nationalised bank, payable to the Manager (प्रबन्धक) Two sets of self-attested photocopies of the mark sheets and certificates for all educational qualifications Two self-attested photocopies of the Aadhaar card

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Tulsidas Udayraj Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya Basti Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 each for Teacher Navya Vyakaran, Assistant Teacher Sahitya and Teacher Modern Subject (Hindi). All three are unreserved (UR).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the college Manager within 21 days of the date the advertisement was issued. The college will not consider applications that arrive after the set date. The advertisement appeared in Dainik Aaj and Amar Ujala from 28 October 2026 to 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification do I need for these teacher posts?
faq.answer: You need to be a postgraduate in the concerned subject, passed in at least second division. Candidates with a traditional degree (परम्परागत उपाधि) get preference.

faq.question: Q4. How much is the bank draft, and who should it be payable to?
faq.answer: Each application needs a bank draft of Rs. 1000 from any nationalised bank, payable to the Manager of Shri Tulsidas Udayraj Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send your application by registered post to: Manager, Shri Tulsi Das Uday Raj Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya, Chitrakhor, Bankati Basti, PIN Code- 272123. Include the bank draft and the self-attested copies of your documents.

faq.question: Q6. Which documents must I send with the application?
faq.answer: Send a Rs. 1000 bank draft. Also send two sets of self-attested photocopies of the mark sheets and certificates for all your educational qualifications, and of your Aadhaar card.

faq.question: Q7. Are these posts full-time?
faq.answer: Yes. All 3 are full-time aided posts in the admissible pay scale. They will be filled under the reservation rules in force from the Uttar Pradesh Government.

faq.question: Q8. Will an incomplete application be accepted?
faq.answer: No. The college will not consider applications that are incomplete, contain errors or arrive after the set date.
